beats.care: Mornings feel cooler, but days warm up again. Carry a light layer for early commutes.
beats.what: The Ridge got 49 mm and Safdarjung 41.6 mm in 24 hours to Monday morning.
beats.why: A thunderstorm spell hit just before the monsoon fully exits. Skies are now clearing.

cards.body: It was 2.3°C below normal and the coolest morning of the month so far. Palam dipped to 17°C.
cards.caption: Safdarjung low on Monday

cards.body: After all that rain, IMD's forecast shows no rain at all from Tuesday to October 18.

cards.q: Delhi's first cool morning felt like…
What does IMD expect for Delhi this week?
cards.why: IMD's bulletin shows partly cloudy, rain-free days with highs of 31–35°C through Oct 18.

hook: Delhi had its *wettest October day* since 2022. What comes next?

learn.t: Delhi's last bigger October rain was on Oct 9, 2022, when Safdarjung got about 74 mm, IMD data shows.

sources.name: Vartha Bharati (PTI)
sources.title: Delhi records wettest October day in four years, minimum temperature drops to 18.7 deg C

tldr: Monday's downpour was Delhi's wettest October day in four years, but IMD now sees a dry, warmer week ahead.
watch: IMD forecasts no rain through October 18, with highs back near 33–35°C.
